drafted: Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed; whitespace anywhere else is invalid.
Units are lowercase only: `3S`, `3MS` and `3Ms` are invalid.
Leading zeros are invalid, except the single digit `0`; only ASCII digits count.
A count may exceed the next unit's size (`90m` is valid); units must still appear in descending order, each at most once.
The empty string and a bare number without a unit are invalid.
No weeks, years or fractional components.
A total above 2^53 - 1 ms is rejected at parse time, never clamped, and an int64 overflow is rejected, never wrapped.
Failures return the zero value and an error whose message names "duration" (parsing) or "milliseconds" (formatting).
`FormatDuration(0)` is `"0ms"`; every other result omits zero components.
